svg.title: Delivery route: one van, 15 customers, 308 km
svg.text: Delivery route: one van, 15 customers, 308 km (HybridSolver)
The solved tour; the van moves at the script's 40 km/h on straight-line legs. No loads or time windows in this model.
Legs: great-circle km between the stops' coordinates. Drive time: distance over speed, no time at the stops.
